text_block_list.text: On this day, I came to a shrine with Seiun Sky for a change of pace, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The weather's so nice, Sei-chan is gonna soak up some sun.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, pass. I'm not really the type to believe in divine blessings or anything like that."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —In the next race, 1st place without fail...!
choice_data_list: Oh, looks like someone's already here.
Huh, looks like someone was here before us.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Indeed, what a fervent prayer that was.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh, Seiun Sky-san.
How long have you been there?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"It's rare to see you in a place like this.
Were you praying for victory?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hardly. I have no need for that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However, to cement our victory,
I felt we should leave no stone unturned, even if it's just for peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I gave God the chance to grant
King's sublime wish, that's all."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So this is kind of like the final touches before the race, huh~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, pretty much.
Why don't you offer a prayer too, and take some time for self-reflection?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall take my leave.
Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
King never changes, does she?
Still...
choice_data_list: I should learn from that attitude.
We should learn from that attitude.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Let me see...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been feeling great lately either,
so maybe Sei-chan should go pay her respects at the shrine too~♪
Afterward, I visited the shrine together with Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Phew, I guess that about wraps it up...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I think I'm feeling a bit better!
Visiting the shrine was totally worth it, even if it's just a placebo~.
Perhaps having completely regained his groove, Seiun Sky seemed to be in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
No particular change worth noting, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, just because you prayed,
it's not like it'll work right aw—

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!
choice_data_list: Did a black cat just run across!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, you're overreacting.
A black cat crossing your path being bad luck is just a superstition.
However, perhaps it wasn't just superstition after all, as Seiun Sky's condition showed no signs of improving...
